g.text: Airflow on CPU Docker / DP1 REST trigger, schedule=None
ingest → validate → publish_to_datahub. DP1 and DP2 trigger the next DAG only
when validation and publication both succeed. DP3 ends at its own publication.
Bronze keeps source path and source-manifest hash. DP3 writes
features/feat_machine_10m and features/label_failure_1h under its stage directory.
Dashed purple = trigger/control. Red = blocked release. Cards name real files/tasks.
